actions.create_candidate.description: Creates a new candidate profile in Greenhouse.
actions.create_candidate.props.email_typ: The type of email address provided.
actions.create_candidate.props.linkedin_: URL to the candidate's LinkedIn profile (e.g. `https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe`).
actions.create_candidate.props.phone_typ: The type of phone number provided.
actions.create_candidate.props.tags.desc: Labels to attach to this candidate (e.g. `referral`, `engineering`). Each item in the list becomes one tag.
actions.create_candidate.props.website_u: URL to the candidate's personal website or portfolio.
actions.create_candidate_note.descriptio: Adds a note to an existing candidate profile in Greenhouse.
actions.create_candidate_note.props.cand: The numeric ID of the candidate to add the note to. Found in the candidate URL in Greenhouse (e.g. `https://app.greenhouse.io/people/**123456**`), or mapped from a previous **Create Candidate** step.
actions.create_candidate_note.props.note: The type of note to create.
actions.create_candidate_note.props.user: Optional. The Greenhouse user ID to attribute this note to. To find it: go to **Configure → Users**, click a user, and copy the number from the URL (e.g. `https://app.greenhouse.io/people/**12345**`).
actions.create_candidate_note.props.visi: Who can see this note. **Admin Only** — only admins; **Private** — only the author; **Public** — all Greenhouse users.
actions.create_prospect.description: Creates a new prospect in Greenhouse — a person who has not yet applied to a specific job.
actions.create_prospect.props.email_type: The type of email address provided.
actions.create_prospect.props.linkedin_u: URL to the prospect's LinkedIn profile (e.g. `https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe`).
actions.create_prospect.props.phone_type: The type of phone number provided.
actions.create_prospect.props.tags.descr: Labels to attach to this prospect (e.g. `referral`, `engineering`). Each item in the list becomes one tag.
actions.create_prospect.props.website_ur: URL to the prospect's personal website or portfolio.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_candidate.description: Searches for a candidate in Greenhouse by email address. Returns the first match.
actions.find_candidate.props.email.descr: The email address to search for. Returns the first candidate whose profile contains this address.
actions.find_due_scorecard.description: Retrieves the full details of a scorecard by its ID. Use with the New Scorecard Due trigger to look up the scorecard that fired the flow.
actions.find_due_scorecard.props.scoreca: The numeric ID of the scorecard to retrieve. Typically mapped from a **New Scorecard Due** trigger step.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.descrip: Searches for a candidate by email address. If no match is found, creates a new candidate profile instead.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.c: Current employer to set on the new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.e: The email address to search for. If a candidate with this address already exists, they will be returned as-is.
The type of email address. Used only when creating a new candidate.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.f: Required when creating a new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.l: Required when creating a new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
LinkedIn profile URL to set on the new candidate (e.g. `https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe`). Ignored if a match is found.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.p: Phone number to set on the new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
The type of phone number. Used only when creating a new candidate.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.t: Tags to attach to the new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
Current job title to set on the new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
actions.find_or_create_candidate.props.w: Personal website or portfolio URL to set on the new candidate. Ignored if a match is found.
actions.update_candidate.description: Updates an existing candidate profile in Greenhouse. Only fields you provide will be changed.
actions.update_candidate.props.candidate: The numeric ID of the candidate to update. Found in the candidate URL in Greenhouse (e.g. `https://app.greenhouse.io/people/**123456**`), or mapped from a previous **Create Candidate** step.
actions.update_candidate.props.email.des: Updated email address. This replaces the candidate's primary email.
actions.update_candidate.props.email_typ: The type of the updated email address.
actions.update_candidate.props.first_nam: Updated first name for the candidate.
actions.update_candidate.props.last_name: Updated last name for the candidate.
actions.update_candidate.props.phone.des: Updated phone number. This replaces the candidate's primary phone.
actions.update_candidate.props.phone_typ: The type of the updated phone number.
actions.update_candidate.props.tags.desc: Replaces all existing tags on the candidate with this list. Leave blank to keep existing tags unchanged.
actions.update_candidate.props.website_u: Updated personal website or portfolio URL.
auth.description:
To connect Greenhouse, you need OAuth2 credentials from a registered Greenhouse partner application.

**Steps to get credentials:**
1. Contact **partner-support@greenhouse.io** to register your integration.
2. Provide: integration name, required scopes, and your redirect URI.
3. Greenhouse will issue a **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

**Required scopes:** `harvest:candidates:list`, `harvest:candidates:create`, `harvest:candidates:update`, `harvest:applications:list`, `harvest:jobs:list`, `harvest:job_posts:list`, `harvest:interviews:list`, `harvest:scorecards:list`, `harvest:notes:create`
triggers.candidate_hired.description: Triggers when a candidate is hired.
triggers.job_updated.description: Triggers when an existing job is updated.
triggers.new_candidate_application.descr: Triggers when a new application is submitted by a candidate.
triggers.new_job_post.description: Triggers when a new job post is created.
triggers.new_scheduled_interview.descrip: Triggers when a new scheduled interview is created within the configured time window.
triggers.new_scheduled_interview.props.d: Only trigger for interviews scheduled to start within this many days from now. For example, `7` means only interviews starting within the next week will fire this trigger.
triggers.new_scorecard_due.description: Triggers when a new scorecard is due — i.e. created but not yet submitted by the interviewer.
